profile.name: JOHN BENEDICT VILLAMOR
bio: I’m a growing creative who enjoys bringing ideas to life through digital art, design, and storytelling. Inspired by the visual style and creativity of Persona, I love exploring bold visuals and meaningful experiences in my work. I’m always learning, improving my skills, and looking for new ways to express my creativity through every project I take on.
